title: Princess Moon and the Nevershine Lantern
subtitle: Book One of the Castle Everstair stories
refrain: But dreams slip through the smallest crack.
styleString: Painterly children's storybook illustration, soft watercolor and colored-pencil texture, visible brushwork, warm golden lamplight against deep indigo night, lavender and pearl-grey stone, generous sparkle and stardust trails, big expressive eyes, gentle rounded shapes, no harsh lines, no photorealism, no text in image.

characters.name: Princess Moon
characters.sheet: Princess Moon: young girl, long wavy pink hair, large dark-blue eyes, rosy cheeks; delicate translucent golden fairy wings with fine filigree veining; silver iridescent mermaid tail with pearl-sheen scales; small gold crown topped with a crescent moon; pearl necklace with a gold crescent pendant.

characters.name: Baby Lady
characters.sheet: Baby Lady: small fluffy cocker-spaniel puppy, golden-cream curly ears, dark round eyes; iridescent pearl-white fairy wings, smaller and softer than Moon's; pale silver-pink mermaid tail in place of back legs — she has no back legs and no back paws, her puppy body ends in the mermaid tail, front paws only; tiny gold crescent charm on a pearl collar.

characters.sheet: Evilest: pale girl, black hair, tall spiky black crown, high-collared black gown, arms crossed, sharp confident smile.

characters.name: Cheeblest
characters.sheet: Cheeblest: pale girl, black hair in two bows and pigtails, deep-purple dress, watchful rather than cruel, eyes slightly too soft for the tower.

cover.imagePrompt: Book cover composition: Moon and Baby Lady together on a castle balcony, a sparkle trail spiraling up from the girl's hand, lavender castle spires and an enormous glowing full moon behind them — and tiny in the far bottom corner, a dark tower where two small figures watch.

questions: Why couldn't the lantern take Moon's favorite power, dreams of hope?
What did Cheeblest want more than crowns or magic?
The Guardians never fell asleep. How do you think Moon's hope reached them?
If you made four bowls of soup, who would you share them with?
lookAndFind: There is a crescent moon hiding somewhere in almost every picture. Can you find them all?

spreads.title: Castle Everstair
spreads.text:
There is a castle with a stair that never stops,
that starts in the sea and climbs past the treetops,
past the clouds, past the wind, past the last bit of blue —
all the way to the moon, and the moon climbs too.
spreads.imagePrompt: Wide establishing shot from below: a lavender fairy-tale castle whose grand spiral stair climbs out of a moonlit sea, past clouds, into an enormous glowing full moon. No characters. Awe, scale, quiet wonder.

vocab.definition: the very tops of tall, tall trees

spreads.title: Princess Moon
spreads.text:
Princess Moon has wings of gold and a tail of silver light,
pink hair like the sky at the soft edge of night.
She has every power a person could hold:
she can bend the fire, she can turn the time gold.

But the one that she loves, the one she picks first,
isn't the strongest, the loudest, the fastest, the worst —
it's dreams of hope. She can look, and she'll see
what somebody's dreaming of wanting to be.
spreads.imagePrompt: Portrait spread: Princess Moon leaning on a balcony rail, chin in hand, sparkle trail spiraling from her hand into the night. Castle spires and full moon behind.

vocab.definition: something special and magical you can do

spreads.title: Baby Lady
spreads.text:
Her sister is small. Her sister is fluff.
Pearl wings, silver tail, and a bark like a huff.
Baby Lady's a puppy. Baby Lady can talk,
and everyone hears her — the fish and the hawk.

She has all of Moon's powers, the whole shining set,
and the two of them never once argue. Not yet.
spreads.imagePrompt: Baby Lady curled on the balcony stone beside Moon's tail, wings half-open and catching light, looking directly at the viewer. Warm, close, cozy.

vocab.definition: a small puff of air, like a tiny grumpy breath

spreads.title: The dark tower
spreads.text:
But across from the stair, where the moonlight goes thin,
there's a tower of stone with the shutters pulled in.
Two sisters live there. Two sisters, alone.
Evilest, crowned. And Cheeblest, in bows.

And what the two want, more than gold, more than land,
is a power that fits in a stolen-shut hand.
spreads.imagePrompt: Composition split: the shining stair on the left, a squat grim black-stone tower on the right. Evilest and Cheeblest standing on its battlement, small against the sky, moonlight refusing to reach them.

vocab.definition: little wooden doors that close over windows

spreads.title: The gift
spreads.text:
So they left them a lantern. They left it out front.
It was pretty. It was quiet. It didn't look blunt.
"A present," said Evilest. "For the girls on the stair."
And Cheeblest said nothing. Cheeblest just stared.
spreads.imagePrompt: Foreground: a beautiful black-glass lantern with an upside-down crescent, sitting alone on a moonlit step, faint sinister shine. Background: two small figures retreating into shadow.

vocab.definition: a little house for a light, with a handle to carry it

spreads.title: The trap
spreads.text:
Moon lifted the latch. Baby Lady leaned near —
and the black glass went hungry. The night disappeared.
No stair. No sky. No silver. No gold.
Just a lantern that swallows whatever you hold.
spreads.imagePrompt: Dramatic: the lantern's mouth open and pulling in ribbons of gold, silver, and pink light; Moon and Baby Lady caught mid-swirl, surprised not gory. Motion, spiral, not frightening.

vocab.definition: a small lock that keeps a door or lid closed

spreads.title: The draining, part one
spreads.text:
First went the fire, a red thread pulled loose.
Then went the water. Then went the use
of the wind, and the growing, and the making-things-mend.
Moon felt them go out like a light at the end.
spreads.imagePrompt: Interior of the lantern: near-total blackness, Moon and Baby Lady tiny and huddled, a single red thread of fire unspooling away from them upward.

vocab.definition: one thin, thin string — like one hair from a sweater

spreads.title: The draining, part two
spreads.text:
Then time. Oh, the time. It went last and went slow,
the way that a very big thing has to go.
And Evilest laughed with her hands full of shine.
"Whatever was hers," she said, "now it is mine."
spreads.imagePrompt: Exterior: Evilest on the tower with stolen light pooled in her cupped hands, colors sitting in her palms like water. Cheeblest slightly behind, not reaching for any of it.

spreads.title: The one they can't take
spreads.text:
Moon was scared. Moon was small in the dark.
Moon had one power left over. One spark.

Because dreams of hope was never inside her —
it lives in other people. That's why it's wider.
You can't take a thing from a girl who won't keep it.
spreads.imagePrompt: Inside the lantern, almost fully dark: Moon's face lit by one small warm point of light held between her hands. Baby Lady's eyes reflecting it. Intimate, hushed.

vocab.definition: one tiny bit of light, like the very start of a fire

spreads.title: What Evilest dreams
spreads.text:
"Then look," said Baby Lady. "Look out. Look through."
So Moon closed her eyes, and she looked, and she knew:

Evilest dreamed of a room made of crowns,
and a hundred bowed heads in a hundred bowed gowns,
and a throne, and a shine, and a very tall chair —
and nobody, nobody, nobody there.
spreads.imagePrompt: Dream-vision panel with soft dissolving edges: a vast hall of crowns, a hundred bowed figures in gowns, an enormous empty throne. Cold, gold, echoing, no faces visible.

vocab.definition: a big fancy chair where a king or queen sits

spreads.title: What Cheeblest dreams
spreads.text:
And Cheeblest — oh, Cheeblest — Cheeblest dreamed small.
Two sisters. One blanket. One wall.
No crowns and no thrones and no swallowing glass.
Just somebody near her. Just that. Just that.
spreads.imagePrompt: Dream-vision panel, soft and small: two little girls on a low wall under one shared blanket, backs to the viewer, stars above. Warm, plain, tender.

vocab.definition: a big soft cloth that keeps you warm and cozy

spreads.title: The crack
spreads.text:
So Moon didn't fight. Moon didn't shout.
Moon took Cheeblest's own dream and she sent it back out,
through the black, through the glass, through the lock, through the seam —

and outside in the cold, a girl felt her own dream.
spreads.imagePrompt: The dream escaping the lantern as a thin ribbon of pink-gold light slipping through a hairline crack in black glass, out into the night — and outside, Cheeblest lifting her face as it reaches her.

vocab.definition: the thin line where two pieces are joined together

spreads.title: Opened
spreads.text:
Cheeblest looked at the lantern. Cheeblest looked at her sister.
Cheeblest thought about blankets. And then she unlatched it.

Out came a puppy. Out came a girl.
Out came a small and a startled hello.
spreads.imagePrompt: Cheeblest's hands unlatching the lantern; light bursting out; a puppy and a girl tumbling free onto the stone. Relief, movement, a startled little hello in the body language.

vocab.definition: opened the little lock so the door could swing free

spreads.title: The long way home
spreads.text:
The stair was so long with no powers to fly.
They walked it. They walked it. They walked the whole sky.
Baby Lady went first, with her nose to the stone,
and she said, the whole way, "You are not walking alone."
spreads.imagePrompt: Long vertical view of the endless stair from far away: two very small figures walking up it, no wings glowing, Baby Lady leading. Sky enormous around them. Determination, tiredness, love.

vocab.definition: all by yourself, with nobody near

spreads.title: The hundred
spreads.text:
And there at the top — every window alight,
every lamp lit and burning, all through the whole night —
stood the Guardians. All hundred. Small, silver, awake.
Captain Pim at the front with her wings all ashake.

"We never once slept," said the Captain. "Not one.
Your hope came right through. So we waited. It's done."
spreads.imagePrompt: Reveal spread: the top of the stair blazing with a hundred lit windows and lamps; a hundred small silver moth-knights arrayed in ranks; Captain Pim in front, wings trembling. Overwhelming warmth after the cold.

vocab.definition: friends whose job is to watch over you and keep you safe

spreads.title: Home
spreads.text:
The powers came back, but they came back slow —
the fire on Tuesday, the time weeks ago,
and Moon found she reached for them less than before,
now she knew what was hers when she had nothing more.

And that night at the table, set out in the light,
were four bowls of soup. Four. That's right.

Two for two sisters with gold wings and pearl,
and two for two others. One crown. One curl.
spreads.theEnd: The End — of the first one.
spreads.imagePrompt: Interior, night: a round table under lamplight with four bowls of soup. Moon and Baby Lady on one side, Evilest and Cheeblest seated across, awkward and small and staying. Crescent motif carved above the door.

vocab.definition: hair that twists round and round like a spring
